newsitem.title: USA: U.S stocks seen opening lower on rate hike worries.
newsitem.headline: U.S stocks seen opening lower on rate hike worries.

text.p: Fears of an interest rate hike are expected to deal a blow to U.S. stocks at Tuesday's open, with oil companies expected to be the only strong sector today after a U.S. attack on Iraq.
The market is anxiously awaiting a spate of economic data due today, including July leading indicators and the National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) August index.
"I expect a possible drop of maybe 20 to 25 at the opening, and then it all depends on the economic news," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
